lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a quasi-linear horizontal pattern along the mid-lateral line. A primary cluster of approximately 5-6 large-diameter blobs is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, with secondary smaller satellites distributed in the dorsal and ventral quadrants.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, particularly in the mid-flank region, where they intersect with the primary horizontal blob clusters to form a structured grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible running longitudinally across the flank. These features exhibit a sharp vertical gradient with a high-luminance superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge, creating a distinct linear relief effect.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three commensal organisms (Echeneidae) located immediately ventral to the right pectoral fin.
